doubts: The page describes one track with two ends for two users: walkers exit at the Pororari River car park (W1, main, 55 km walking, which matches the leg distances summed from Smoke-ho car park); mountain bikers exit at Waikori Road car park (W2, 56.2 km, with its own distance in the Pororari Hut section). W2 is treated as its own way because it has its own distance; its time and distance are the mountain biking figures from the Description. The Pororari River car park has no feature entry, so the W1 end ref is null. The start is the Smoke-ho car park at the end of Blackball Road, given ref F4 (the unnamed track meeting Blackball Road). The Pororari River and Waikori Road car parks are both listed under 'accessed by road', so they are recorded as access points; the page does not say what they join. The Punakaiki River Valley has no entry of its own (T22 is the Punakaiki River), so no ref is given. The Pororari River Gorge ref (T20) is taken from the name in the text 'a spectacular gorge' in the Pororari Hut section. Croesus Top Hut is passed by both ways but may only be used for shelter.
